key_insight: HISPO improves long-form mathematical reasoning by applying importance-sampling correction at an intermediate segment level, balancing token-level and sequence-level credit assignment.
engineering_relevance: For RLVR systems, segment-level policy optimization offers a practical way to better allocate credit in long answers and potentially improve training stability and final reasoning accuracy.
method: Build contiguous response segments from rollout-time entropy signals.
Assign soft saliency weights from segment entropy.
Apply clipped importance-sampling correction at the segment granularity.
evidence_signal: Fine-tuning Qwen3-1.7B-Base on six math benchmarks, HISPO improved Pass@8 on all benchmarks and achieved stronger or equal Acc@8 on five, including AIME25 gains over GRPO and GSPO.
watch_item: Entropy-derived segmentation adds an extra design choice, so performance may depend on segmentation quality and the chosen clipping/saliency settings.
paper_title: HISPO: Hierarchical Importance-Sampling Policy Optimization with Entropy-Derived Segments
